title: Poorly Made
text:
Poorly Made. I bought this item because we do not have a dishwasher [apartment living!] and with the amount of dishes we wash, water was always pooling on the counter or standing in the dish rack. The concept behind this item is that water is supposed to run out through drain holes on to the provided drain piece and then out to the sink. You have the option of mounting it the long way or the short way - so far so good, right? Well, the piece arrived, stylish, as others have stated, but it is not engineered to channel water toward either of the two draining sides. In other words, the water still just puddles up on the bottom and doesn't go anywhere unless you tip the whole thing toward the holes, which is difficult when there are items in it. Further, the attachment that holds two cups or glasses on the side doesn't actually mount; it just sort of hangs on, making it very prone to being knocked off when empty.
I guess the answer is to go out and buy some stick-on "feet" so I can tilt it to the angle I want, which will hopefully make this item do what it is supposed to have done in the first place. Gee, if I can think of that, why can't SimpleHuman?
